tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on paper and grey-100, the primary button fill, the strip bar on paper, inverted states (selected, scored, final) and the judge filmstrip's rebate. 18.9:1 on paper, 16.9:1 on grey-100.

tokens.name: viewing
tokens.usage: The photo viewing surface of the judge view, nowhere else; also what shows through the filmstrip perforations. Text on it: paper (11.4:1) or grey-200 (8.4:1). Control outlines on it: grey-500 (3.2:1).

tokens.name: grey-600
tokens.usage: Secondary and small text, mono labels: 6.5:1 on paper, 5.8:1 on grey-100. The key hint on the selected (paper) score key (6.5:1). On viewing only as the decorative 1 px dividers of the judge view (1.8:1), never as text there.

tokens.name: grey-500
tokens.usage: Control outlines, key-cap outlines, the strip track and unscored badges: 3.5:1 on paper, 3.2:1 on grey-100 and on viewing, 5.3:1 on ink. As text only on ink (filmstrip frame numbers, the unscored dash, 5.3:1); never text on paper, grey-100 or viewing.

tokens.name: grey-200
tokens.usage: Hairlines on paper and the StageChip outline (1.4:1, decorative, never the only boundary of a control). Secondary text and icons on viewing (8.4:1).

tokens.name: grey-100
tokens.usage: Thumbnail wells and the selected list row. Text on it: ink (16.9:1), grey-600 (5.8:1), error (5.8:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground, the gallery wall. Text and marks on ink (18.9:1) and on viewing (11.4:1); the fill of the selected score key and of scored badges.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Validation errors only, always with the error icon and words: the message text and the 2 px invalid-input border. 6.5:1 on paper, 5.8:1 on grey-100. Never on viewing (1.7:1) or ink (2.9:1).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on paper (18.9:1) and grey-100 (16.9:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, column labels and mono labels on paper (6.5:1) and grey-100 (5.8:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1 px hairlines that divide content on paper (list rows, the app bar, panel section heads) and the StageChip outline. Decorative: a control always has a control-line or ink boundary.

tokens.name: control-line
tokens.usage: 1 px outlines of inputs, outlined buttons on viewing, score keys, key caps and unscored badges; the dashed outline of a locked button; the strip track. 3.5:1 on paper, 3.2:1 on grey-100 and viewing, 5.3:1 on ink.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Behind a thumbnail shown whole (the entrant's 64 px well, a portrait in the organiser's thumbnail grid) and the selected list row.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill: the primary button, the final-stage StageChip, the account initials (18.9:1).

tokens.name: on-viewing
tokens.usage: Primary text on viewing, the strip bar and active tab underline there, the selected score key fill (11.4:1).

tokens.name: on-viewing-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and icons on viewing (8.4:1): the wall-label description, counters, the keyboard legend, the locked button's label.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on paper and grey-100: focus-width solid at focus-offset (18.9:1, 16.9:1).

tokens.name: focus-on-dark
tokens.usage: Focus ring on viewing and on ink: focus-width solid at focus-offset (11.4:1, 18.9:1).

families.mono: "DM Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles on desktop (Natečaji). One per page, in text.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Section titles on wide pages. Drawn only on the brand board so far.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Panel titles on desktop: the contest name heading the organiser's detail panel.

styles.name: h2-mobile
styles.usage: Section titles at phone width (Your entry). The brand board's H2 20/28.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Contest names in ContestRow and in the entrant's mobile header (which adds -0.01em letter-spacing).

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Sub-section heads inside a panel (Sodniki, Prijavljene fotografije) and the contest name in the judge's app bar.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pogled s Kureščka ob sončnem vzhodu, november 2025.
styles.usage: Default UI text, photo descriptions, desktop input text. Key dates in ContestRow use it at 600; desktop button labels use its size at 500 (primary 600).

styles.name: body-dense
styles.usage: Dense lists and rows (ContestRow figures at 500, JudgeRow names at 500); compact button and tab labels use its size.

styles.name: input-mobile
styles.usage: Text in a TextField at phone width; 16 px stops iOS Safari zooming on focus. The full-width mobile primary button uses it at 600. On desktop, inputs use body.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary lines, the judge's keyboard legend, deadline lines. Stage names in ContestRow use it at 600.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels above a TextField, error messages (in error, after the error icon) and links inside small text (Vseh 12 preteklih).

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: You can change or withdraw your entry until 15 Nov 2026.
styles.usage: Captions, helper text, the label over a key date, stage names under the ticked strip.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: The brand board's DM Mono specimen: photo IDs, frame numbers and pixel sizes set at text size.

styles.name: photo-id
styles.usage: The top line of the judge's wall label (PhotoLabel): the anonymous ID at 500 in on-viewing, the position in on-viewing-muted.

styles.name: frame-number
styles.usage: Frame numbers under filmstrip frames: grey-500 on ink; the current frame at 500 in on-ink with ▸.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Column and section labels in text-muted; the entrant's rules line and technical line (the slot number 01 at 500 in text).

styles.name: mono-caption
styles.usage: The k / 5 counter beside a segmented strip and the ID under an organiser thumbnail, in text-muted.

styles.name: score-numeral
styles.usage: The selected score repeated large on the wall label, readable across a room; followed by / 10 at 20/24 in on-viewing-muted.

styles.name: photo-title
styles.usage: The photo title on the judge's wall label (PhotoLabel), in on-viewing. One per screen.

styles.name: score-key
styles.usage: Numerals on the ten score keys of ScorePad; the selected key at 700. The numeral is centred in the 64 × 60 key.

styles.name: key-cap
styles.usage: Labels in a KeyCap (legend, Počisti). Inter, never DM Mono: DM Mono's slashed zero reads as Ø on the 0 key. On the 48 px Prejšnja and Naslednja buttons the cap is 12/16 at 500.

styles.name: key-hint
styles.usage: The key hint in the top-left corner of each score key (6 px in, 4 px down): on-viewing-muted, grey-600 on the selected key.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label in tight spots, gaps between tabs, thumbnail to its caption.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related lines and controls (score keys, thumbnails in a grid, label to strip).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a thumbnail and its fields, between paired buttons, wall-label ID to title.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row padding, filmstrip frame gap, gaps between controls; mobile gutters.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups; the judge view's side margins (app bar, dock, filmstrip, wall label).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections; the viewing grey around the judged photo; between the organiser's list and panel.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Desktop page margins.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: App bar height; large section breaks.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons and inputs on paper, and the minimum size of any tap target on a phone. Desktop-only compact controls go below it: Počisti 36 px, Zaključi ocenjevanje and the account button 40 px, SL / EN 32 px.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photos, thumbnails, wells, panels and surfaces. Photos are never rounded.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips, badges, key caps, score keys, the account initials.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: The app icon tile only.

stroke.note: Line weights. Elevation is never used: separate with hairlines and the well fill.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers in line, control outlines in control-line, the strip track.

tokens.name: stroke-strip
tokens.usage: The strip bar, the active tab underline, the rule heading a detail panel.

tokens.name: stroke-error
tokens.usage: Border of an invalid input; the inner padding drops by 1 px so the text does not move.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, solid, in focus or focus-on-dark.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its focus ring.

film.note: The judge filmstrip: 35 mm proportions, 8 perforations per frame.

tokens.name: perf-width
tokens.usage: Perforation hole width in the judge filmstrip.

tokens.name: perf-height
tokens.usage: Perforation hole height.

tokens.name: perf-pitch
tokens.usage: Distance between perforation holes (5 px hole, 11 px bridge).

tokens.name: frame-width
tokens.usage: Thumbnail frame width in the judge filmstrip (frames are 75 px tall, cover crop).

tokens.name: frame-pitch
tokens.usage: Frame plus its 16 px gap: exactly 8 perforations per frame.
